The trading or retirement-account link is an attributed sponsor referral; the supplied content does not show a false identity, controlled-funds offer or guaranteed return, so a strong price prediction alone does not establish a scam.

opening.argument: The pitch links a concrete buying recommendation to outsized projected XRP appreciation: the speaker says he is adding to his own long position, calls the moment a buying opportunity, and projects a 100%–300% short-term rally. That is more than detached price reporting; it encourages viewers to acquire the asset on the strength of those projections. The description also supplies multiple XRP and crypto trading links, including an attributed affiliate link. Taken together, the return thesis and routes to buy make this function as token-purchase promotion, even though the material does not establish what any viewer ultimately did.

Nor does identifying a sponsor referral resolve the separate effect of the direct XRP-buying links and the video’s purchase-oriented message. The combination can solicit participation without proving a guaranteed return or controlled-funds scheme.

The supplied material cannot verify the forecasts or establish that the offered routes deliver the outcomes the pitch encourages viewers to expect.
